verdict.rationale: Several documented features target time-to-first-token: SDK TCP warming, msgpack/gzip payload optimization, priority service tiers, dedicated reserved capacity, automatic prompt caching, Predicted Outputs and streaming. Hands-on community reports call generation exceptionally fast (over 300 tok/s cited, and outpacing a self-hosted 8x H100 setup), and one developer built a voice assistant on it. Missing for 10: first-party quantified TTFT and tokens-per-second figures or independent TTFT measurements, and evidence that shared-tier throughput holds up given reports of instantly hit per-minute request limits and capacity strain during traffic bursts.
